snippet.title: Classic Manager: Football | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Remember those nights? Just one more match… That late-night football management feeling, now on your phone. 2001/02 and 2026/27 squads, live text commentary, transfers, tactics. First season free. Search for "Classic Manager: Football" on the App Store / Google Play Store
